expectation: Cytoplasmic/fibrous SMA in smooth muscle, myofibroblasts and pericytes: bright rings lining vessels, elongated fibres and bands in stroma, with epithelium and lymphoid areas largely negative. Moderately common.
observed: A: yellow rings round vessels, long curved bands and fibrous tracts in stroma, with dim-signal regions and nuclei-rich areas that are mostly unstained, and strength varying between cores. B/C: elongated fibre bundles next to blue-dominant cellular areas. D: a ring-like wall of stained cells.
why: Vessel-wall rings and stromal fibre tracts are stained, while neighbouring cell-dense areas are mostly negative, which is the SMA pattern expected.
